_about: Round 20 (2026-11-26): Anthony said yes to a 'Sound detail' choice on the web page (Minimal, Balanced, Rich). The run's 'current' tile is Balanced, today's live settings with the real-recordings library.

variants.label: Minimal
variants.why: Only the main sound of each shot and at most four big moments. No second close look.

variants.label: Rich
variants.why: Claude lists every sound it can see, up to six per shot and twelve key moments, and the second close look may add up to twenty more small ones.
